hints.title: Yearly Total Aggregation
hints.text: Calculate the total annual expenditure for each customer by summing prices grouped by customer and year.

hints.title: Continuous Active Span
hints.text: A customer must have no gap years between their minimum active order year and their maximum active order year.

hints.title: Strict Monotonic Growth
hints.text: Every adjacent consecutive calendar year transition for the customer must strictly increase in total annual spend.

hints.title: Consecutive Year Join Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
WITH YearlyOrders AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id, 
        YEAR(order_date) AS year, 
        SUM(price) AS price
    FROM Orders
    GROUP BY customer_id, YEAR(order_date)
)
SELECT CurrYear.customer_id
FROM YearlyOrders AS CurrYear
LEFT JOIN YearlyOrders AS NextYear 
  ON CurrYear.customer_id = NextYear.customer_id 
 AND CurrYear.year + 1 = NextYear.year 
 AND CurrYear.price < NextYear.price
GROUP BY CurrYear.customer_id
HAVING COUNT(*) - COUNT(NextYear.customer_id) = 1;
```

complexity.notes: Grouped aggregation followed by self-join on consecutive calendar years.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated subqueries scanning all historical records for each order run in quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) intermediate memory to aggregate yearly expenditures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Enforces both strictly increasing spend and zero missing calendar years.

solutions.approach: Consecutive Calendar Year Join with Count Verification
solutions.code:
WITH YearlyOrders AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id, 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)::INTEGER AS year, 
        SUM(price) AS price
    FROM Orders
    GROUP BY customer_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)
)
SELECT CurrYear.customer_id
FROM YearlyOrders AS CurrYear
LEFT JOIN YearlyOrders AS NextYear 
  ON CurrYear.customer_id = NextYear.customer_id 
 AND CurrYear.year + 1 = NextYear.year 
 AND CurrYear.price < NextYear.price
GROUP BY CurrYear.customer_id
HAVING COUNT(*) - COUNT(NextYear.customer_id) = 1;
